initial_turn.subject: Inquiry Regarding Product Availability and Details for Menu Planning
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I am reaching out on behalf of French Bakery as we are currently in the process of updating our menu and are exploring new product options to offer our customers. To ensure we select the most suitable items, I would appreciate your assistance in providing detailed information regarding the availability and any relevant specifications for several products listed in your catalog.

Specifically, could you please confirm whether the following items are currently available for order, and if so, provide any pertinent details such as packaging, minimum order quantities, or lead times?

- Pizza (I noticed there are a few variants: AITEM-0050, AITEM-0051, and AITEM-0052; could you clarify the differences between these, and which are available?)
- Soda - Small (AITEM-0060)
- Kalamata Olive (AITEM-1005)
- WonderWash Washing Machine (AITEM-0100)
- T-Shirt (I see several entries: AITEM-0022, AITEM-0023, AITEM-0024, AITEM-0025, and Generic Golden T-Shirt AITEM-0019; could you explain how these differ and which are suitable for staff uniforms?)

If there are any brochures, product sheets, or additional documentation available for these items, please include them as well. We are particularly interested in understanding any distinguishing features or options that might help us make an informed decision.

Best regards,
French Bakery
